What the garage does

From the sign above the workshop and from what customers describe on Google.

Panel beating and paint

The sign above the workshop names panel beating and painting, in Greek and Russian. One customer writes that after the bodywork the car looks like new.

Accident repair

One customer had the damage estimated with the insurance company at the garage. Parts, bodywork and paint on the bumpers followed, and the car was fully fixed in less than two weeks.

Pre-purchase inspection

Six reviews mention a check before buying a used car: a careful inspection, a test drive and a clear list of what actually needs fixing.

Mechanical repairs

Customers name brakes, a shock absorber sourced and fitted within 24 hours, and a new radiator with a flushed cooling system.

In the workshop

Photos from the garage’s own Facebook page and Google listing.

How a visit works

Taken from what customers describe in their Google reviews.

Quick appointment

One customer got an appointment within about 15 minutes. Another needed an urgent service and was helped the following day.

Explained clearly

Five reviews mention clear explanations. One customer was shown all the old parts and what was replaced with new ones.

English, Greek, Russian

Customers write that the mechanic speaks English, Greek and Russian, so every step is easy to follow.

Body and mechanics in one garage

Aidinidis Garage works from a workshop at Petraki Kyprianou 71 in Geroskipou, near Paphos. The sign above the entrance names panel beating and painting, in Greek and Russian. In the Google reviews, customers describe accident repairs, scratches on rental cars, inspections before buying a used car, and mechanical work from brakes to radiators. All 70 reviews give five stars, and several mention fair prices and honest advice.

What customers say
